Name: Lucius of Cyrene
Summary: Lucius of Cyrene was among the prophets and teachers at Antioch who, as they ministered and fasted, heard the Spirit set apart Barnabas and Saul for the work of the Gentile mission.
KeyStory: Lucius stood among the Antioch teachers when the Spirit said, Separate Barnabas and Saul for the work.
LifeLesson: Mission begins in worship, not in planning. Lucius fasted with the church that sent the first missionaries.
